Download Link: https://itunes.apple.com/in/app/super-sam-adventures/id791098087?mt=8

Description 

Tilt left and right to collect boosts, coins and avoid traps!

Oh no! An evil alien monster has kidnapped Sam's sheep! Help him rescue them while exploring new worlds and completing exciting missions! 

FEATURES
- Complete missions to save sheep!
- Use special boosts to complete missions faster and better! 
- Upgrade your boosts to increase their performance 
- Unlock a variety of superhero costumes
